format: CSV with one row per attempted live or replay trial
block_design: Every acquisition block contains all 128 arm-bound-predecessor-actual-predecessor-target cells exactly once; positions rotate uniformly over 128 blocks.
retention_rule: Every attempt and reset failure is retained; live adaptation cannot rewrite a sealed replay transcript.
claim_boundary: Passing records reject predecessor-conditioned adaptation within the declared controller input manifest; undeclared physical side channels remain an apparatus-security question.
